name: Shopee (Sea Group)
summary: Candidates report an HR call followed by about three technical rounds that mix LeetCode medium to hard coding with computer science fundamentals (networking, operating systems, databases), then system design and a hiring-manager round for experienced hires.

rounds.name: Recruiter screen
rounds.what: Informal call on your resume and experience; some interns and senior candidates report skipping it.

rounds.name: Online assessment
rounds.what: Some candidates get an online coding test before the live rounds; NodeFlair reports mostly medium problems.

rounds.name: Technical interview
rounds.what: Live coding (one report: two problems in 45 minutes) plus questions on networking, operating systems and databases.

rounds.name: System design
rounds.what: SDE-2 report: a 90-minute round on designing a service, data sharing between microservices, HTTP and TCP, plus a coding problem.

rounds.name: Hiring manager
rounds.what: Walkthrough of a past project, production debugging and how you would collect and display metrics.

tips: Aim for the optimal solution and be ready to explain and improve time and space complexity.
Revise CS fundamentals: TCP vs UDP, HTTP, processes vs threads, deadlock, indexes and isolation levels.
Some rounds require code that actually runs, so practise in a plain editor.
Prepare a past project in depth, including an incident you debugged in production.
